summary: Move the eval and example source corpora to evals/fractal and examples/fractal, updating runnable declarations, indexes, scripts and Rust fixture consumers.

replay.detail: No stored eval migration: bundle archives use eval-root-relative paths and content hashes, not repository directory names.

schema.detail: No schema change; the hidden .st3-documents directory and its document bytes are retained.

compatibility.detail: Repository source paths change; binary names, environment contracts, persisted paths and recorded historical evidence remain unchanged.

manual.detail: Use the new repository paths for evals and examples.

recovery.detail: Revert the source-path rename; stored bundles remain independently readable.
